services.name: Kissimmee Boat Rental
services.desc: There are many water ways in the Orlando and Kissimmee area but none are as large as West Lake Toho (Lake Tohopekaliga). It spans 42 miles and covers over 22,000 miles. It is the largest lake in Osceola County. It is well known for Bass fishing and hosts one of the professional Bass Masters tournaments each year. West Lake Toho also connects to East Lake Toho through a 3 mile canal. The most common launch point is Kissimmee Marina by Lake Toho which was formerly Big Toho Marina. Also nearby, is Richardson’s Fish Camp. Both supply live bait. Kissimmee Marina also has public restrooms, food and drinks (including alcohol).
